question:
Prince starts from Point A and walks 6 km toward south, and then turns to the right, walks for 4 km. He takes a final turn to the left and walks 6 km. Now, in which direction is he from the starting place?

(All turns are 90 degrees turns only)
solution:
Based on given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1034a2bfef937f10a2ef09a19c1eeac0cf52110981c6711a90622f602d9a2549.png]
